data.body: INVESTIGATION COMPLETE (2026-05-12): This bug requires an architectural decision (4 options documented in ticket description). Confirmed design gap — _phase_resolve_threads, _dispatch_fix_agent, and _phase_resolve_conflicts all require _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD/_REMEDIATE_LLM_CMD/_RESOLVE_CONFLICTS_LLM_CMD to be set, and all have CI-environment guards that prevent local dispatch. In a local session these three phases always ESCALATE+exit on first blocker. The local-mode loop was removed in S3 (line 940: 'LLM helper was deleted in S3'). Fix requires new sprint/epic — not a hotfix. Recommendation: Path 4 (new /dso:finalize-pr skill) is most DSO-native. Marking COMPLEX and leaving open for sprint.
